summary: Mandatory licensing for industrial premises employing 10+ workers with power or 20+ workers without power.

steps.title: Site and building plan approval
steps.description: Submit manufacturing flowcharts, machinery layout, and ventilation plans for pre-construction clearance.

steps.title: Pollution control consent (CTE)
steps.description: Obtain Consent to Establish from State Pollution Control Board before factory operation.

steps.title: Submit Form 2 application
steps.description: Fill online application providing details of installed horsepower, worker capacity, and welfare facilities.

steps.title: Inspectorate on-site audit
steps.description: Factory inspector conducts safety audit verifying guards on machinery, sanitation, and first aid provisions.

steps.title: Grant of Factory License
steps.description: Obtain Factory License valid for 1 to 5 years with annual renewal option.
